name: Temporal
summary: Temporal is a durable execution platform where workflows are written as ordinary code and their event history is persisted, so a workflow resumes where it left off after failures. Workers run in your infrastructure and poll a Temporal service, which can be self-hosted (open source) or used as Temporal Cloud. It is widely used for long-running business processes and, increasingly, for AI agent loops.
facts: Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Rust
From $50 per 1M actions plus storage; $150 starter credits
watchOut: Workflow code must be deterministic; versioning takes care
Self-hosting the cluster is operationally heavy
Per-action cloud billing adds up for chatty workflows
